# Copper Wren Movement Studio: 2029 Rooms and Travel Note

Alder Room has a step-free entry from Finch Street.
The accessible bathroom for Alder Room is beside the west foyer.
Birch Room’s rear entrance closes at 18:00 on weekdays.
The low-sensory waiting room must be requested from the office in advance and is subject to availability.
The Saturday connector coach departs Finch Street at 09:35.
The Saturday connector coach does not operate during school holidays.
A connector coach ticket costs $8 per single ride and must be reserved through the office.
The $8 connector coach ticket does not cover showcase coach travel.
Cedar Room is reached from the east gate, which has three steps.
